create_virtual_reminder.name: Create virtual reminder
create_virtual_reminder.description: Adds a new reminder — the same thing typing one into ClassDash's own Reminders section does. Shows up on the matching class's calendar once created. Returns the created reminder, including its id — the only way to get one back for a later Edit call, since a reminder isn't its own entity.

config_entry_id.name: ClassDash server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if more than one ClassDash server is configured.

class.name: Class
class.description: Which class this belongs to — free text, doesn't have to match a class ClassDash already tracks. Leave blank for a general reminder with no class.

due.name: Due
due.description: When it's due. Leave blank for a reminder with no real deadline.

edit_virtual_reminder.name: Edit virtual reminder
edit_virtual_reminder.description: Changes an existing reminder's title, class, and due date. Title, class, and due are always replaced together — leaving class or due blank clears it, this isn't a partial update.

config_entry_id.name: ClassDash server
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if more than one ClassDash server is configured.

id.name: Reminder ID
id.description: The id Create virtual reminder returned when this reminder was made.

title.name: Title
title.description: What the reminder says. Always sent — even if unchanged, resend the current value.

class.name: Class
class.description: Which class this belongs to — free text. Leave blank to clear it (no class), not to leave it unchanged.

due.name: Due
due.description: When it's due. Leave blank to clear it (no real deadline), not to leave it unchanged.
